races.name: KBIS British Equestrian Insurance EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Amir Lehbab
runners_data.spotlight: 150,000euros foal, 200,000gns yearling; seventh foal; No Nay Never brother to two winners notably Rudi's Apple (6f 2yo; RPR 97), half-brother to three winners including The Vegas Raider (1m2f-2m,; 82); dam Group-placed 7f/1m winner; likely to improve for this first run but respected nevertheless.

runners_data.name: Arabian Blue
runners_data.spotlight: 150,000gns yearling; second foal; Blue Point half-brother to 1m/1m1f winner I Am Me (RPR 82); dam once-raced half-sister to winners including Emaraaty Ana (6f Group 1), out of 1m4f Listed winner; it's possible he's one for further down the line but is worth a second look given his purchase price.

runners_data.name: Cavalier
runners_data.spotlight: 80,000euros foal, 95,000euros yearling; third foal; Minzaal half-brother to 7f AW winner They All Know Me (RPR 81); dam 6f winner (including 2yo; 87), half-sister to 5f 2yo Listed winner Dave Dexter; one of four declared runners for Richard Hannon and the betting can be informative on debut.

runners_data.name: Cloud Summit
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; first foal; dam runner-up 1m in US, half-sister to Cheveley Park and 1,000 Guineas winner Special Duty; trainer's 2yos are running well and this No Nay Never newcomer is one to watch in the betting.

runners_data.name: Herbert Hall
runners_data.spotlight: 8,000euros yearling, resold £36,000 yearling; by Starman; first foal; dam unplaced 7f-1m 2yo (RPR 62), sister to winners Agitare (useful 7f-2m Flat and 2m3f jumps) and Make Me Sway (1m), closely related to 6f-7.5f winner Holistic Approach; others debutants make greater appeal on paper.

runners_data.name: Jimtrott
runners_data.spotlight: 110,000gns yearling; first foal; dam French Listed-placed 9.5f AW winner (RPR 90), out of maiden half-sister to 1m6f Group 3 winner California; trainer can ready one first time; this No Nay Never newcomer is not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Keep Grating
runners_data.spotlight: 35,000euros yearling; eighth foal; Space Traveller half-brother to winners Dazzling Des (5f-6f including 2yo; RPR 85), Merry Secret (6f/7f; 74), Private Affair (5f AW 2yo; 73) and Blue Moon Baby (5f 2yo; 56); dam 5f 2yo winner (91); one of four for the stable; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Night Star
runners_data.spotlight: 46,000euros foal, £60,000 yearling; fourth foal; Space Traveller half-brother to 6f winner Smoke Them Out (including 2yo; RPR 86); dam 6f winner (78), half-sister to two winners; one of four for the stable; some of the other newcomers possess more paper appeal.

runners_data.name: Percy Shaw
runners_data.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; seventh foal; Bated Breath brother to Listed-placed 5f winner Lady Tilbury (including 2yo; RPR 100), half-brother to 6f winner Rinky Tinky Tinky (64); dam 5f winner (81), half-sister to 7f Listed winner; no surprise if he gives a good account on debut.

runners_data.name: Silver Dominion
runners_data.spotlight: 200,000euros yearling; third foal; dam French 10.5f winner, half-sister to 7f Group 1 winner Aclaim and smart 1m3f-1m5f winner Aimeric; purchase price catches the eye and this Gleneagles newcomer could run well.

runners_data.name: Sole Ambition
runners_data.spotlight: 150,000gns foal, 210,000gns yearling; by No Nay Never; second foal; dam Group-placed 6f winner (RPR 98), half-sister to useful 6f 2yo/7f winner Elinor Dashwood; likely to improve for this debut run but not discounted.

runners_data.name: Al Qayed
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; from the first crop of the stable's superstar Baaeed; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to two classy winners, out of 7f Group 3 winner; makes debut with yard in flying form and could have a big say.

runners_data.name: Rafe's Da Man
runners_data.spotlight: Backed into 9-2 for last month's debut at Lingfield (7f, good); interesting to see if his supporters return but he was beaten a long way and needs to be an entirely different proposition this afternoon.

runners_data.name: Note To Self
runners_data.spotlight: Drifted out to 100-30 for last month's debut at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) and was beaten 7l in fifth of six; however, he's with a leading stable and may be able to leave that opening performance miles behind.

runners_data.name: Sydney Rock
runners_data.spotlight: All three runs at 7f as 2yo, running to a fair level (from the front) on final two starts; pedigree suggests she'll improve for the extra furlong now handicapping but she may also come on for this belated return.

runners_data.name: Lahan Kingman
runners_data.comment: Distant second (at odds-on) to her main market rival on comeback; drops in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Good start on 7f debut here as 2yo, keeping on steadily into third behind one who has proved Group-class since; no clear progress in two AW runs (7f and 6f) this year and while the switch to handicap company, back on turf and upped to 1m, makes her of interest, first-time blinkers give pause.

runners_data.name: The Stone Power
runners_data.comment: Promise on debut and latest third came in a warm race; more to come and he is a key player
runners_data.spotlight: Shortish prices despite some difficult assignments in all three AW runs, at 7f and 1m; failed to find much on sole run at this trip but gelded since last seen in January and is worth considering on turf and handicap debut for top yard; market can guide.

runners_data.name: Alpine Culture
runners_data.comment: Third in maidens at Newmarket and Yarmouth; shaped as if today's longer trip will suit
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced on slower than good; showed promise in 7f and 1m maidens at Newmarket and Yarmouth in April but out of his depth on handicap debut over 1m2f at the former track and his race was run over 2f out; should have more to offer back at 1m.

runners_data.name: You Sexy Thing
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise against talented rivals before winning a 7f Sandown handicap (soft) last August, relishing that stiff finish; creditable show in a higher grade at Doncaster after before well held in a valuable sales race last October; gelded since and he should stay 1m; of interest.

runners_data.name: Luminare
runners_data.comment: Not the most consistent and off four months, but still a player if producing her best form
runners_data.spotlight: Won 5f novice at Bath for previous trainer and a 7f handicap on Newcastle AW for this one last December; beaten in three handicaps since and although she might have needed the latest one, when back on turf at Lingfield (7f, good) after a break, she's likely to need more back at 1m.

runners_data.name: Box Clever
runners_data.spotlight: Won an ordinary 7f maiden at Salisbury (good to firm) last August on third outing; had surface queries (heavy then AW) on final 2yo starts but she resumed with a good run at Nottingham (about 1m, good), where she kept persevering when chasing home a next-time winner; can progress further.

runners_data.name: Storm Point
runners_data.spotlight: All five runs at 7f and 6f on AW, finding extra to hold rivals at bay on handicap debut at Kempton in April, then his path was blocked at Lingfield next time; the step up to 1m may be less of a problem than today's conditions on turf debut.

runners_data.name: Mayflower Billy
runners_data.comment: Not achieved much in three runs at big prices; easy enough to look elsewhere
runners_data.spotlight: Best qualifying run over 1m and he found only one too good at Doncaster when back at that trip (good to soft) on handicap debut in May; up 4lb against unexposed rivals so improvement likely to be needed but conditions may be less of a problem for him than some.

runners_data.name: Slack Bob
runners_data.spotlight: Kept to 6f and 7f in first five starts; possibly just needed the outing when keeping on at the same pace over 1m at Yarmouth in April and although a subsequent quite impressive win came over 7f on Lingfield AW he shouldn't be written off back over this trip on turf.

runners_data.name: Suggy
runners_data.comment: Beaten a head over C&D in November and a few winners have come out of that race; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Has found his feet in Kempton AW handicaps at 1m on last two starts, just worn down (by one who would have been an unlucky loser) last November, then found a bright turn of foot to win on comeback; up just 4lb but he has a different question to answer this time, returned to turf with rain about.

runners_data.name: Forty Years On
runners_data.spotlight: Close third on debut last March then won her next three, completing the hat-trick on handicap debut at Ascot (7f, soft) in September; head second at Southwell (7f, AW) 16 days later and the winner landed the Hambleton at York last month; makes reappearance and could prove to be well treated.

runners_data.name: City Of Kings
runners_data.comment: Very lightly raced 6yo but he has plenty to prove after a mammoth absence; new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Three runs for Charlie Appleby up to April 2023, winning at Ascot on the middle outing; gelded since and sold for 140,000 UAE Dirham in March 2024; on a handy mark if retaining his past promise and he's one to watch in the betting on stable debut, but it's a very hefty absence to defy.

runners_data.name: I Still Have Faith
runners_data.comment: On a long losing run but some good form this season and he might not be far away
runners_data.spotlight: On a long losing sequence but twice went close on AW earlier this year and he was denied a clear run when 2l fourth of 11 at Newmarket (7f, good) last month; seems versatile ground-wise; might not be far away.

runners_data.name: Brian
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten on final two runs last year (1m, AW) and same story on his three outings this spring (6f, AW/good/good to firm); arrives with something to prove but he's 5lb lower than when runner-up over C&D (soft) last October and the return to slow ground could facilitate a major revival.

runners_data.name: Best Rate
runners_data.spotlight: 0-14 since winning in December 2024 on third start but he's been a close fourth over 7f on AW on two of his last three starts, and he ran well on good to soft last August when he last tackled turf (unraced on softer); solid each-way contender.

runners_data.name: Spangled Mac
runners_data.comment: Returns from another spell in Bahrain; hasn't won a domestic race since 2023
runners_data.spotlight: 7yo who was well beaten in Bahrain and at Chester on his last two starts; however, he was drawn wide at Chester and showed some good form in Bahrain in January; he's run really well on both previous attempts at this C&D and is not ruled out each-way off a competitive mark.

runners_data.name: Chalk Mountain
runners_data.comment: Ended last season with a C&D win and he needs watching in the market on his return
runners_data.spotlight: Went very close in this last year (good) and, having ended 2025 with a win at Kempton (7f, AW), he reappeared with another there (7f) last month; he can be bang there if handling conditions (unproven on slow ground).

runners_data.name: I'm Workin On It
runners_data.comment: All four wins have been over C&D and latest was two weeks ago; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Made it 4-9 in AW handicaps when winning at Kempton (7f) last month and went close there next time (7f); key player if transferring his form back to grass; well beaten here on sole turf start but that was his debut back in September 2024.

runners_data.name: Nostrum
runners_data.spotlight: Has considerable back-class (including on soft ground) and he's shown promise on both starts for this yard, most recently runner-up at Sandown (1m, good); high on the list on the back of that performance.

runners_data.name: Morte Point
runners_data.comment: Pair of duck eggs this term don't tell the whole story; record of 1211 over 7f previously
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins last August/October, the first over C&D (good); also effective on good to soft (unraced on softer); however, he's struggled on his three runs this spring; hopes pinned on wind op prompting dramatic turnaround.

runners_data.name: Storm Free
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who has a largely solid record and may still have more to offer
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in the Victoria Cup at Ascot (7f, good) last time but prior to that he made an encouraging reappearance at Newmarket (7f, good) and he won in a big field at Leicester (7f, good) last October; unraced on slow ground; this lightly raced 4yo retains potential and has first-time headgear.

runners_data.name: Warm Spell
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win (from 12 races) came in C&D novice in July 2023; reduced mark appeals on some good efforts last August/September but he's been well below that level on both outings this spring; unproven on slow ground.

runners_data.name: Ata Rangi
runners_data.comment: C&D winner off 2lb lower last September; can go well fresh; needs serious consideration
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins last season (1m/7f, AW/good) and he added another on last month's reappearance at Haydock (7f, good); his best form has come on good ground but he's shown promise on a slow surface and this progressive 5yo could still have more to offer; respected.

runners_data.name: Consecrated
runners_data.comment: 0-4 since easy debut win but possible she'll take sizeable step forward at some point
runners_data.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) last April on debut; hasn't really progressed and has finished merely seventh in 1m6f/1m2f Listed races on her last two starts (tailed off last time); however, it's possible this half-sister to connections' crack 6f/7f performer Sacred will appreciate the drop back in trip.

runners_data.name: Obsidian Dream
runners_data.comment: C&D win as a 2yo; stood little racing since; back from another break with a point to prove
runners_data.spotlight: On a competitive mark on his best form and he's effective on soft ground; this lightly raced 4yo might have needed the run at Bath 16 days ago following a break but he's inconsistent and others are more compelling.

runners_data.name: Tanmawwy
runners_data.comment: All six wins on turf over 6f/7f; steps up in trip on this return from a 556-day layoff.
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a long way at 50-1 at Salisbury last month on first run since 2024 and this 8yo has to prove how much ability he retains; however, he's on a dangerous mark on his 2024 exploits and might not be a forlorn hope.

races.name: Tonight's Super Boost Live At BetVictor Handicap

runners_data.name: Wild Clary
runners_data.comment: Back on the up when beaten neck at Ripon; reliable and has notably solid credentials
runners_data.spotlight: A Southwell maiden win last summer remains his only success after 15 attempts but he has run good races in defeat in all three starts this year; conditions should suit well and he is more appealing than most.

runners_data.name: Righthere Rightnow
runners_data.spotlight: 0-12 since his wide-margin debut win as a 2yo but he ended 2025 with some good runs and went close in Dubai in December (6f, good to firm); his last two runs at Meydan weren't his best but a break may have freshened him up and he is on a dangerous mark.

runners_data.name: Never Just A Dream
runners_data.spotlight: Smart performer on AW for Ismail Mohammed; one good run and two modest efforts for Alice Haynes last year; potentially thrown in now starting out for the excellent Terry Kent but he does have to prove himself on turf (stiff tasks on last two attempts).

runners_data.name: Justcallmepete
runners_data.comment: Scored on penultimate start but only 2-23 on turf and current mark looks difficult
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; five wins since joining Tony Carroll, including turf handicaps in two of his last three starts; should give his running once again but may prove vulnerable for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Moving Force
runners_data.comment: Last of nine at Goodwood 19 days ago on stable debut following lengthy absence.
runners_data.spotlight: A fairly useful 5f juvenile winner for Richard Fahey; low-key stable debut last month but fared much better when second of ten behind the reopposing Hockney at Kempton (6f; 50-1) three weeks ago; best turf form achieved on faster ground.

runners_data.name: Hockney
runners_data.comment: Won twice over 6f last September; below that level since returning this year.
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who landed a gamble on his handicap debut at Lingfield (6f, AW) last September and made short work of following up at Thirsk one week later; slow start to his 2026 campaign but things clicked back on AW at Kempton three weeks ago, gamely repelling the reopposing Moving Force; could progress further after just eight runs.

runners_data.name: Kiniro
runners_data.comment: Two AW wins for previous trainer; met trouble on recent return for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice on Lingfield's AW track when trained by Harry Charlton; promising stable debut at Chester last month (met trouble from a poor draw) and although he couldn't land a blow at York last time, he didn't run poorly by any stretch; Oisin Murphy back in the saddle; slower than good would be a query.

runners_data.name: Pressure's On
runners_data.spotlight: Usually seen over further but he goes well on slow ground and is only 1lb higher than for his big-field win at York last summer (7f, good to soft); big run wouldn't be a bolt from the blue.

runners_data.name: Golden Long
runners_data.comment: Consistent over 6f in Hong Kong; beaten fav in 5f events for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly trained in Hong Kong; gambled on ahead of his British debut at Southwell in February (5f) and shaped with plenty of promise; only third at Yarmouth in April but he made no mistake at Windsor last month (6f, good to firm; runner-up has won since); the combination of a  6lb rise and slower ground may find him out.

races.name: HMC Horse Boxes EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Aunt Roberta
runners_data.spotlight: 85,000euros yearling; tenth foal; Sea The Stars sister to three winners including Fifty Stars (Australian 6f-1m2f including Group 1), half-sister to winners Revolver (1m4f-2m1f; RPR 107) and Whiskey Sour (7f-2m1f Flat; 105); market check advised on debut but a useful standard is needed.

runners_data.name: Hatta Romance
runners_data.spotlight: 22,000gns 2yo; by Frankel; second foal; dam 7f/1m 2yo winner (including Group 2), out of Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; makes debut with yard among the winners but a watching brief is probably wisest.

runners_data.name: Manaar
runners_data.spotlight: 175,000gns foal, 370,000gns yearling; fifth foal; St Mark's Basilica half-sister to three winners, notably the stable's Dubai Honour (prolific 1m-1m4f including Group 1); intriguing newcomer who could have a big part to play.

runners_data.name: Pseudonym
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; Australia half-sister to 7f/1m 2yo winner Ghostwriter (including Group 2); dam Listed-placed 1m4f AW winner; makes debut in a warm contest but it will be interesting to see how she goes in the betting.

runners_data.name: Miss Scott
runners_data.spotlight: 650,000gns yearling who has an attractive pedigree and readily made a winning debut at Leicester (7f, good to soft) last September; her breeding suggests this longer trip will suit and she's a strong contender under a penalty; wears a first-time hood.

runners_data.name: Shady Dame
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up on debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last September and not disgraced when sixth of ten in Group 3 Oh So Sharp Stakes there (7f, good) in October; her dam was a 1m6f Group 3 winner and the step up in trip could be a good move on her reappearance; firmly in calculations.

runners_data.name: Tropical Sands
runners_data.comment: Stable had a well-backed 3yo newcomer go in at Newbury last month; market informative
runners_data.spotlight: 28-1 and beaten just over 7l when fourth of 12 on last month's debut at Lingfield (1m, AW); however, she made some late headway and could be sharper for that experience; not ruled out over this extra furlong.

runners_data.name: Pierpoint
runners_data.comment: 33-1, hinted at ability on Newbury debut (7f) but 5l behind stablemate Tarrant
runners_data.spotlight: 33-1 and 40-1 this spring on her first two starts (7f/1m2f, good); she's shown ability but improvement is needed to come out on top today.

runners_data.name: Mountain Of Light
runners_data.spotlight: She cost 425,000gns in 2024 and her inexperience was evident when well beaten at 11-1 on debut at Haydock (1m, good to firm) in April; however, she's probably best watched until showing some promise.

runners_data.name: Tarrant
runners_data.comment: Promising 3rd of 11 on Newbury debut (7f); very likely to improve; major contender
runners_data.spotlight: Third in a hot newcomers' race here (7f, good) in April; another good performance when third in slowly run maiden at Ascot (1m2f, good) last month; she's a leading form player today.

runners_data.name: Trelissick
runners_data.comment: Kingman filly who made an encouraging start at Kempton last month; could be in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Encouraging fourth of 14 on debut at Kempton (7f, AW) in April; didn't build on that when seventh of ten at Windsor (1m, good) last month but she stumbled leaving the stalls and could get closer to the target today.

runners_data.name: Glenna
runners_data.comment: 12-1, creditable fourth of nine on handicap/seasonal debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good)
runners_data.spotlight: Produced best run yet when fifth of 14, beaten just under 3l, over 1m2f here (good) four weeks ago having made the running; has also shown promise on soft ground; however, she needs something extra today to get off the mark.

runners_data.name: Hard To Believe
runners_data.comment: Novice wins on the last two of three starts; encouragement for this trip on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Bath (1m, good to soft) last October on second start and followed up in Wolverhampton novice (9.4f, AW) in March; unplaced favourite on handicap debut at York (1m4f, good) four weeks ago but he retains potential and it will be no surprise if he poses far more of a threat today.

runners_data.name: Cosmo Brown
runners_data.comment: Down the field at big odds this spring on first two starts (1m, good) and has lots to find
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field at big odds this spring on first two runs (1m, good) but showed improved form in a first-time hood (retained) when third at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) last time; the manner in which he kept on provides optimism for 1m4f and he's one to consider on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Barrister
runners_data.comment: First two runs not devoid of promise but will be of greater interest once handicapping
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fourth at Kempton (7f, AW) on sole 2yo start and, while he's been well beaten in novices here (1m2f, good) and at Kempton (1m3f, AW) on both runs this year, he's been behind classy winners; has far more realistic claims on this handicap debut; interesting, especially if backed.

runners_data.name: Mythical Bay
runners_data.comment: Good form when 2nd at Chester last time but he didn't look straightforward; may do better
runners_data.spotlight: Won Wolverhampton novice (9.4f, AW) in January on fourth start and returned from break with close second on handicap debut at Chester (1m4f, good) last month; only third of four at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) but that was still a good run and he could be in the shake-up today.

runners_data.name: Honouramongthieves
runners_data.comment: First reserve, unplaced in two handicaps, 73-rated gelding looks out of his depth
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 and he needs to produce more than he's managed in Ireland this spring in his first two handicaps (1m4f/1m3f, good to yielding/good); however, his trainer has an excellent 13-41 (32%) record with his British raiders in the last five years; firmly in calculations in first-time headgear.

runners_data.name: Impossible Mission
runners_data.comment: Returned to turf when tailed off at Newmarket (1m2f, good; 40-1) latest; caution advised
runners_data.spotlight: Won on nursery debut at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) last November; flopped on his first two runs this year but back on song with 5l third of 11 at Haydock (1m2f, good to soft) three weeks ago, when shaping as though this step up in trip could be a good move; respected.

runners_data.name: Kindly Queen
runners_data.spotlight: Close fourth on handicap debut at Kempton (1m4f, AW) in March and runner-up in first-time blinkers (retained) at Windsor since (11.4f, good to firm; first turf start); in good hands to continue to progress; key player.
